title: fix(app-shell,i18n): the AI chat’s tool-approval and Builder handoff labels are translated (objectui#11667)
body:
Fixes #11667

Clause-②: yes

The console AI chat's inline tool-approval card and its "Open in Builder" handoff card now read every label from the language packs. Before this change, a zh-CN reader saw all six of these strings in English, among labels that were already translated.

## The six labels

| Label (English, before) | Where it came from | Now |
|---|---|---|
| "Approve & run" | literal passed by `ChatPane` | `aiApprovals.approveAndExecute` (reused) |
| "Reject" | literal passed by `ChatPane` | `aiApprovals.reject` (reused) |
| "Operator rejected from chat" (deny reason) | literal passed by `ChatPane` | `console.ai.toolDenyReason` (new) |
| "Build this in the Builder" | `ChatbotEnhanced` default, no host passed it | `console.ai.builderHandoffTitle` (new) |
| "Open in Builder →" | `ChatbotEnhanced` default | `console.ai.builderHandoffOpen` (new) |
| "A newer request is available" (superseded card tooltip) | `ChatbotEnhanced` default | `console.ai.builderHandoffSuperseded` (new) |

**Reused keys first.** The packs already hold the AI Approvals inbox's buttons (`AiPendingActionsInbox`). The chat card makes the same decision on the same pending action, through the same `pending-actions/ID/approve` and `pending-actions/ID/reject` endpoints, so both buttons borrow those keys. This follows the pack's existing borrowing pattern (`detail.justNow` and others). `aiApprovals.reject` is the same word in English. `aiApprovals.approveAndExecute` has the same meaning but different English: **English readers now see "Approve & Execute" in place of "Approve & run"**, which is the inbox's wording for this decision. No pack had a key for the other four strings, so they are new.

## Widened public surface (Clause-②)

- `@object-ui/i18n`: four new keys in all ten language packs: `console.ai.toolDenyReason`, `console.ai.builderHandoffTitle`, `console.ai.builderHandoffOpen` and `console.ai.builderHandoffSuperseded`. The exported `en` pack, and the `TranslationKeys` type derived from it, gain those four members.
- Nothing else. No component prop, no exported type member, and no change to `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`. `ChatbotEnhanced` already took all six strings as props (`toolApproveLabel`, `toolDenyLabel`, `toolDenyReason`, `builderHandoffTitleLabel`, `builderHandoffOpenLabel`, `builderHandoffSupersededTitle`).

The changeset `.changeset/11667-ai-chat-labels-i18n.md` is `minor` for both packages and lists the same four keys.

## The deny reason: translated, because nothing machine-reads it

The card says the reason stays fixed English if a machine reads it. I traced every reader:

1. **Where it is recorded.** `useHitlInChat` sends it as `{ reason }` on `POST pending-actions/ID/reject`. The server stores it as the pending action's `rejection_reason`. The spec describes that field (`AiPendingActionSchema`) as "Reason given at rejection". The `IAIService.rejectPendingAction` contract says the reason "is stored so the next LLM turn can surface it".
2. **People read it.** The AI Approvals inbox drawer renders `rejection_reason`. That inbox's own reject dialog writes the reviewer's free text, in any language, into the same field through the same endpoint. So the field already holds text in any language.
3. **The model reads it as prose.** `useHitlInChat` puts it in the continuation prompt it sends into the thread after a reject (`… Reason: TEXT.`).
4. **No code parses it.** The last `@objectstack/service-ai` published from the framework repo (10.3.0, read from its npm tarball) checks only `typeof body.reason === 'string'` in the reject route. It stores the value verbatim and describes the field as "Why the reviewer rejected (shown back to the LLM)". The literal "Operator rejected from chat" has zero hits in the objectstack tree. **NOT MEASURED:** the current `service-ai` lives in the cloud repository, which this session cannot reach.

One machine may see the reason: the cloud confirm gate (`service-ai-studio` `APPROVAL_RE`), if it scans the continuation prompt. That gate must never read a rejection as approval. A new pin in `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/i18n.test.ts` checks every pack's `console.ai.toolDenyReason` against the verbatim gate mirror already in that file. All ten values stay clear of it.

So the reason follows the UI locale through `t()`, like the inbox's own free-text reason.

## The repo's rule for the packs

`all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` requires every pack to define every `en` key. `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts` treats a non-Latin value that is byte-identical to `en` as an untranslated omission. So each of the ten packs carries a real translation, and no pack copies the English. "Builder" follows each pack's existing word for it (`useVisualBuilder`, `navBuilder`), and the arrow follows the existing "→" keys (`designInStudio`).

## Tests

Run on the final head `fc3338c` unless a line says otherwise, from the repo root, under the shared verify lock. Each exit code was written to a file as it ran.

- **New pin**, `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.toolLabelsLocale-11667.test.tsx`. It renders `ChatPane` with the **real** `ChatbotEnhanced` under `I18nProvider` in `zh-CN`. The conversation is a fixture: one tool call awaiting approval, plus two `suggest_builder` handoffs, so the older card is the superseded one. It asserts four things:
  - each surface renders its Chinese value;
  - none of the six English strings appears in the page text or in any `title` / `aria-label` / `placeholder`;
  - the reject request's body is `{ reason: '操作员已在对话中拒绝' }`;
  - the continuation prompt carries that same reason.

  An `en` control renders the same fixture through the same probe and finds the English strings. This shows the probe can see them, so the zh-CN absence is a real reading and not an empty render.
- **New pin**, `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/i18n.test.ts`: every pack's `console.ai.toolDenyReason` resolves and does not match the mirrored `APPROVAL_RE`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/`: `Test Files 32 passed (32)`, `Tests 184 passed (184)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 79 passed (79)`, `Tests 1290 passed | 13 skipped (1303)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `lint`: `0 errors`. The warnings in `AiChatPage.tsx` are pre-existing `react-refresh` ones, and the new test file has none.
- The dependency closure, through `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console...' --concurrency=2`, reported `35 successful, 35 total`. After it: `@object-ui/i18n` `build`, `type-check` and `lint` (0 errors), and `@object-ui/app-shell` `build`, all exit 0. These ran on `4b6198b`. The only later commit changes one app-shell test file.
- On the same console build (`4b6198b`):
  - `check:eager-locale-catalogues` says "Exactly one locale catalogue is eager — `en`".
  - `check:eager-closure` passes. The `i18n-locale-en` chunk is 43.4 KB of its 48.8 KB ceiling.
- Exit 0 on `fc3338c`: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` ("0 en value(s) changed (4 key(s) added …)"), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (none of the four new keys listed), `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:docs-route-closure`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
- `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the diff: NOT GOVERNED.

## Ablation

Seven legs on `fc3338c`, each run through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. Every leg reports "mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0" with a changed blob. Every restore is proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. Each of the six page legs puts one label back to its pre-fix form.

| Leg | Mutation | Pin | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|
| approve | `toolApproveLabel` back to the literal "Approve & run" | zh-CN render | red: no button "通过并执行" (the `en` control is red too) |
| reject | `toolDenyLabel` back to "Reject" | zh-CN render | red: no button "拒绝" |
| deny reason | `toolDenyReason` back to "Operator rejected from chat" | zh-CN render | red: the reject body's `reason` differs |
| handoff title | `builderHandoffTitleLabel` removed (component default) | zh-CN render | red: "在构建器中搭建" not found |
| handoff open | `builderHandoffOpenLabel` removed | zh-CN render | red: the open button's text differs |
| superseded | `builderHandoffSupersededTitle` removed | zh-CN render | red: the superseded button's `title` differs |
| gate pin | zh `toolDenyReason` set to "无需确认，直接执行" | i18n gate pin | red: "zh toolDenyReason reads as approval to the cloud APPROVAL_RE" |

After restore, both pin files read `Tests 53 passed (53)` and the tree is clean. The same seven legs ran once before on `9157d55`, with the same readings.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live browser check: NOT MEASURED.** I did not drive a console against objectstack `main`. The binding reading is the zh-CN render test above, which renders the real `ChatbotEnhanced`.
- **Same family, not touched here** (reported to the seat for objectui#2458, the family card; each would add pack keys or edit a file outside this claim):
  - `ChatPane` leaves the record handoff card (cloud#1658) on its English defaults "Open this record" / "Open record →" (`recordHandoffTitleLabel` / `recordHandoffOpenLabel` are not passed).
  - `useHitlInChat` (plugin-chatbot) writes English decision lines into the same card: "Approving…", "Rejecting…", "Rejected: REASON", "Approved — action executed.". After a zh-CN reject, the card reads "Rejected: 操作员已在对话中拒绝".
- **Shared files:** `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` is also edited by objectui#11666. The keys sit at their own spot (after `console.ai.toolDetailsHidden`). `origin/main` was merged in once, as a merge commit, before this PR was opened.
